acceptanceCriteria: CLI help states the exact custom-output path boundary and that repo-visible reports affect clean-worktree admission.
Default private report behavior and output confinement stay unchanged; retain focused help/readback evidence.
body: Observed with Core1.0.0-rc.1build163 during GH390 closeout. Default OCM report writes safely under the private Git directory. An explicit /tmp output is refused unsupported-ocm-output-path; an explicit .corvint/change.ocm.review.json writes a visible untracked file, which correctly blocks frozen selected-check verification until moved. This is documentation friction, not a safety-boundary defect. Reproduction and evidence: corvint ocm report --help; attempts retained in impact lane OCM closeout logs and /tmp/impact-ocm-output-search.json (no existing match). Expected: help describes accepted explicit-output confinement and visibility, so an operator can choose the private default. Actual: help does not state the boundary. Preserve the confinement and clean-worktree enforcement.
